t: A northern Thai kingdom founded by Mangrai, who took Hariphunchai and built Chiang Mai as his capital in 1296.
Under Tilokarat in the fifteenth century it fought Ayutthaya and became a leading centre of Pali Buddhist learning.
Burma ruled it for most of 1558–1775, after which its principalities passed under Siam.
dyk: The Emerald Buddha, now Thailand's most sacred image, was kept in Chiang Mai from 1468 until the early 1550s, when it was taken to Lan Xang.
ev: Mangrai conquers the Mon kingdom of Hariphunchai
Mangrai founds Chiang Mai as his capital

Tilokarat convenes a Buddhist council at Wat Chet Yot
